title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our growing platform team. You'll own features end-to-end, from technical design through deployment, working closely with product, design, and infrastructure. Our stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on AWS. You'll have significant autonomy to shape both the product and the engineering culture as we scale.
responsibilities: Design and build scalable features across the full stack
Lead technical planning for medium-to-large projects
Mentor mid-level engineers through code review and pairing
Collaborate with product and design on roadmap and tradeoffs
Improve developer experience, tooling, and CI/CD pipelines
Participate in on-call rotation (one week every 6-8 weeks)
requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern React
Experience designing and operating production Node.js services
Solid grasp of relational databases and SQL performance
Track record of shipping user-facing features end-to-end
Excellent written communication for async collaboration
nice_to_have: Experience with AWS (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3)
